description: Sim is a comprehensive open-source AI workspace designed for teams to build, deploy, and manage AI agents. The platform offers a versatile environment where users can develop agents either visually or through code, ensuring flexibility for different technical skill levels. By supporting every major Large Language Model (LLM), Sim allows organizations to leverage the most effective AI technologies for their specific operational needs.
